description: Read-only local context-adapter profiles for Graph-RAG rerank, summary and fact extraction. Local AI is optional and never becomes source of truth.

profiles.description: MVP profile for token-saving Graph-RAG context prefiltering with deterministic fallback.

operations.output: JSON array of source chunk ids, scores and reasons
JSON summary with cited source chunk ids and uncertainties
JSON facts with source chunk ids, confidence and uncertainties

fallbacks.description: Deterministic rerank, summary and fact extraction from already source-backed Graph-RAG chunks.
Stable no-agent fixture mode for tests and workstations without a local AI runtime.

safety.writes_runtime_outputs_to: tmp/graph-rag only when --write or --out is passed
safety.secret_handling: Adapter input may only use selected Graph-RAG chunks that already passed rag-sources filters.
safety.truth_boundary: Graph queries and cited source files remain authoritative; local model output can only rerank, summarize or extract cited facts.

result_evidence.truth_boundary: Adapter result evidence must name requested and actual mode; mock and local outputs are never source of truth.
